english.note: Use this everyday verb for obtaining or getting something you wanted.
Use this when secure means successfully obtain or get possession of something, especially a result, position or opportunity.

examples.english: I finally managed to score a concert ticket.
examples.traditional: 我終於攞到張演唱會飛喇。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 zung1 jyu1 lo2 dou2 zoeng1 jin2 coeng3 wui2 fei1 laa3

examples.english: I finally managed to secure the job.
